what_if_question: What if universities stopped granting degrees and only issued live competency profiles?
changed_condition: A degree is replaced by a continuously updating public record of demonstrated skills.
short_scenario: Students no longer graduate once. Their profiles rise and fall weekly as classes, jobs, and platforms feed assessment data into a shared credential system.

affected_stakeholders.name: students
affected_stakeholders.impact: They gain more granular recognition but lose the stability of a completed credential.

affected_stakeholders.name: employers
affected_stakeholders.impact: They can filter candidates continuously, increasing pressure on students to remain measurable.

discussion_questions: Can a person ever finish being evaluated?
image_prompt: A black-and-white document-style live competency card with changing skill bars, official stamps, and appeal notes.
semantic_summary: A speculative education credential system where students live inside continuous assessment.
